description.item: Architected and deployed a full-stack time tracking SaaS (zerve-app) with React 18 + TypeScript frontend, Flask API backend running on AWS Lambda via apig-wsgi, DynamoDB with pluggable PostgreSQL support via repository pattern, and Cognito JWT authentication.
